== Description ==
#ヘイデイ #HAYDAY - Hay Day William - New Machines, Machine Upgrades has Ricky Burnett aka R3DKNIGHT playing his sons farm. Williams hay day farm is progressing nicely and a new machine was added. The truck event gave his hay day farm the chance to get more xp before running out of goods and the free hay day diamonds from the supercell hay day team allowed us to upgrade machines.

Enjoy as we play and chat. Listen for any hay day tips on how to play as well.

Don't forget to sub, like and comment below.
